timing_scope.gpu: Device initial field to complete device trajectory and diagnostics
timing_scope.with_host: Host initial field to complete host trajectory and diagnostics; input transfer, query and output transfer from the same invocation

timing_statistic: Median over all retained paired case/repetition invocations
accuracy_statistic: Per-case maximum across repetitions; evolved excludes the initial field, all-times includes it
ratio_scope: Same-job FOM/model timing ratio; matched-target claims require the separate accuracy, reference and stationarity flag
limitations: Dense full-grid weak evaluation; no hyper-reduction speed claim
Warm bank lineage is not an independent complete training seed
audit_qualifications: The original strict local parameter gate is retained as failed. Two NumPy CPU implementations round scalar exp differently; all original data and final query results are retained unchanged.
